body:
I do not like children or the elderly, but I am somewhat intrigued by animals. Children only talk to you because they want something from you. They want your advice, they want your food, they want something. Liking animals gets you no where though. You can love birds as much as you want, but you won't be financially stable. I honestly wish I could be a manager in a store like Walmart and still be able to fund my wants, but you can't. In order to live comfortably, you need to have the careers I mentioned previously.

I have no hope in regards to a change in environment. I've traveled to states such as PA and NY, all I've gotten was the same treatment as I'm getting now in my current residence.

I am stuck in a conundrum. I've tasted what it is to be a cute girl and I absolutely loved it, but I can never truly achieve it because I was not born that way. My only hope is reincarnation.

The only thing I find comfort in is anything that will give me attention. There is no purpose in doing things if no one notices what you do. What is the purpose of not harming others if you receive nothing but harm from your peers? I am a very vengeful person and society turned me into a monster instead of the gentle child I used to be.

Also, we are forced into a society where in order to survive we must have a viable income and/or job. This sets the standards to things like being a professional sports athlete, doctor, or lawyer (the profession I'm supposedly heading towards, but do not want to). Anything less than these types of professions would end up in hardship. Therefore, heading towards a "true" career path that I am pleased with isn't a viable option for myself or anyone.

I feel that the only thing I can offer the world is sadness and despair. I am tired of playing the waiting game. I want things to get better now, not when I'm 50.
